topic: Mutual Fund and ETF Fees and Expenses
source_evidence: This item will appear in the prospectus fee table when the fund has agreed to reduce fees or expenses, temporarily or indefinitely.
answer: A fee waiver or expense reimbursement means a fund has agreed to reduce its fees or expenses. The reduction may be temporary or indefinite, so it may not last permanently. The fund may also recoup those waived or reimbursed amounts in the future. Check the prospectus fee table for this information when reviewing a fund’s costs.
